Noble Rules

30-Day Level Validity

Recharge to unlock Noble levels and exclusive benefits.

  1. Eligible Recharge
    Noble Recharge Coins include personal In-App and Official Website recharge, Coins received from Coin Traders, and the corresponding Recharge Bonus. Coin Trader inventory top-ups and other non-recharge Coins do not count.
  2. Unlock & Upgrade
    Without Noble, recharge accumulates without a time limit. Reach a threshold to receive the highest eligible level. If you already hold Noble, only a higher eligible level is granted immediately.
  3. 30-Day Validity
    Each granted level lasts 30 days. Your highest valid level is Current Noble. Upgrading does not change the expiry dates of levels you already hold.
  4. Skipping Levels
    You receive only the final level and its benefits. Skipped levels and their exclusive decorations are not granted.
  5. Recharge Progress
    Obtaining or upgrading a level resets progress to 0. Excess Coins do not carry over. Subsequent recharge starts accumulating immediately, across days and multiple payments.
  6. Renewal & Expiry
    When Current Noble expires, recharge accumulated since the last reset determines your next 30-day level. Progress then resets to 0. Below 2,400,000 Coins, no new level is granted. Noble status ends when no valid level remains.
  7. Same-Level Renewal
    Reaching your current or a lower level’s threshold does not renew it early or reset progress. This also applies to LEGEND: accumulate 160,000,000 Coins during its validity to renew at expiry.
